units.title: Colours Around Us
units.description: Identifying and naming basic colours found in nature.
steps: Look at the sky, grass, and sun. Name their colours.
Identify objects that have more than one colour.
Understand that a rainbow has many colours in a specific order.

units.title: Describing What We See
units.description: Using simple words to describe natural beauty.
steps: Practice saying 'The sky is blue' or 'The flower is red'.
Understand that we can use different words to describe the same thing.
